scope: Photo-mode frame, shutter and the three existing bottom HUD icons
textureIconLimit: These are filled raster silhouettes. The outline adds visual weight; their pixel thickness is not claimed to be exactly doubled.
visualReview: Root and independent reviewer compared the real Play screenshot against PhotoWeight/Before/photo.png. Frame corners and shutter are continuous. WASD letters, camera opening and journal leaf remain legible. The earlier 1.25 outline was rejected because it filled these cutouts.
inputEvidence: Production E/C/J/Esc actions; no hardware keyboard injection and no complete photo-save-to-journal claim.
